period.label: Conditional annual coverage equivalent from the 2012 onsite NOC staffing statement

scope.label: At least one continuously occupied onsite NOC coverage position at the Windstream/TierPoint Little Rock data center; employment relationship unallocated

interval.interpretation: Mathematical zero-leave lower bound conditional on the facility-specific statement that the onsite NOC was staffed 24/7/365; not observed employee headcount.

provenance.detail: Facility-specific statement that the onsite network operations center was staffed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year
Forty scheduled hours per week for 52 weeks, with zero leave, training, breaks, overlap, or relief allowance

estimates.confidence_rationale: The continuous onsite staffing statement is facility-specific and the division is exact. The result is conditional and cannot distinguish employees from contractors, actual headcount, multiple simultaneous posts, leave relief, residence, occupation, or payroll.
estimates.decision_relevance: Provides a conservative floor for the labor coverage embodied by a documented 24x7 onsite operating function without inflating it with an unsourced relief factor or relabeling it as people employed.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Actual headcount, employer/contractor status, simultaneous posts, schedules, relief coverage, leave, occupations, payroll, and worker residence

derivation.formula: 24 hours/day × 365 days/year ÷ (40 hours/week × 52 weeks/year)
assumptions: At least one onsite NOC coverage position was continuously occupied as the operator statement says.
One zero-leave FTE-equivalent supplies 2,080 scheduled hours per year.
No relief factor or multiplier is applied.

limitations: FTE-equivalent coverage is not employee headcount or payroll.
Employment relationship, contractor status, worker residence, occupation, wages, benefits, and actual staffing levels are unknown.
Real operations require breaks, leave, training, overlap, and relief, so actual labor supporting one continuous post would exceed this zero-leave floor.
The 2012 statement does not establish persistence at the same staffing arrangement in later years.
estimates.notes: Conditional mathematical lower bound only. Do not count as observed employees, filled jobs, resident employment, or a current staffing snapshot.

Power factor, utilization, PUE, contracted service, loading, critical-load share, and annual meter data are hypothetical or missing, so the wide envelope is an engineering sensitivity rather than an actual-use estimate.

derivation.formula: one-side MVA × power factor × utilization × 8,760 × 1,000 ÷ PUE
assumptions: Only one 2N transformer side is used and the redundant side is not additive.
Low/central/high scenario bundles use PF 0.8/0.9/1.0, utilization 25%/50%/75%, and PUE 2.0/1.6/1.2.
The calculation represents hypothetical IT energy behind the service transformer, not facility meter use.

limitations: No scenario parameter is observed at this facility.
Transformer nameplate may exceed contracted or usable service.
PUE division simplifies losses and non-IT loads and is not a substitute for metering.
The range is not a confidence interval, forecast, environmental impact, or actual consumption.
Generator capacity, tank volume, and the 85 kW per-cabinet maximum are excluded.
estimates.notes: Wide one-side engineering sensitivity only. Do not present as observed electricity use, utility load, emissions, or both-side 2N capacity.
